div.b: 4. AXI Master Wrapper FSM (Split Read / Write Independent Channels)

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
WRITE CHANNEL FSM
---------------------------------
M_WR_IDLE: Wait write_req
M_WADDR: AWVALID=1, AWLEN=len-1
↳ Wait AWVALID & AWREADY
M_WDATA: WVALID=1, WDATA=reg
↳ WLAST=1 on final beat
↳ Loop until WVALID & WREADY & WLAST
M_BRESP: BREADY=1, Wait BVALID

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(67, 160, 71), rgb(65, 145, 69));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 388px; height: 1px; padding-top: 900px; margin-left: 482px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
READ CHANNEL FSM
---------------------------------
M_RD_IDLE: Wait read_req
M_RADDR: ARVALID=1, ARLEN=len-1
↳ Wait ARVALID & ARREADY
M_RDATA: RREADY=1, Latch RDATA
↳ Track beat_cnt
↳ Complete on RVALID & RREADY & RLAST
M_DONE: Return rdata_valid

div.div:
WRITE CHANNEL FSM
---------------------------------
S_WR_IDLE: Wait AWVALID
S_WADDR: AWREADY=1, Latch AWADDR/AWLEN
S_WDATA: WREADY=1, Write SIP FIFO
↳ Loop beats until WLAST & WREADY
S_BRESP: BVALID=1, BRESP=OKAY
↳ Complete on BVALID & BREADY

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 398px; height: 1px; padding-top: 900px; margin-left: 1412px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
READ CHANNEL FSM
---------------------------------
S_RD_IDLE: Wait ARVALID
S_RADDR: ARREADY=1, Latch ARADDR/ARLEN
S_RDATA: RVALID=1, Fetch SIP Data
↳ RLAST=1 on final beat
↳ Hold RVALID if RREADY==0
↳ Complete on RLAST & RVALID & RREADY

div.b: 6. RTL Register & Interface Signal Map for Code Implementation
div.span:
Common Regs: state, next_state, beat_count, addr_reg, burst_len, size_reg, write_reg, error_flag, req_ready, resp_done
AHB Interface: HCLK, HRESETn, HADDR[31:0], HWRITE, HSIZE[2:0], HBURST[2:0], HTRANS[1:0], HREADY, HRESP, HWDATA[31:0], HRDATA[31:0], HREADYOUT
AXI Interface: AWADDR, AWLEN, AWSIZE, AWBURST, AWVALID, AWREADY | WDATA, WSTRB, WLAST, WVALID, WREADY | BRESP, BVALID, BREADY | ARADDR, ARLEN, ARSIZE, ARBURST, ARVALID, ARREADY | RDATA, RRESP, RLAST, RVALID, RREADY
